title: Decoding candidate count bound
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with label set $ in q$, and assign to each vertex a Boolean-valued function on the Boolean cube. If $0<ε≤1$, then at every vertex the number of decoding candidates is at most $3/ε^2$.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean-valued function is given at every vertex
